name: Thief Gold
description: Thief Gold is a singleplayer first-person stealth and immersive sim game, an expanded edition of Thief: The Dark Project.

steam.store_details: The original build, without the NewDark engine patch.
steam.patches: TFix bundles the NewDark engine patch along with a range of modern-system fixes, and is worth installing alongside EAX.

gog.store_details: It comes with the NewDark engine patch pre-installed.

audio_settings.title: Enable underwater reverb
audio_settings.reason: Some Thief Gold maps don't mark their underwater areas, so they play the wrong reverb there.

optional_settings.title: Enable full-precision mouse look
optional_settings.reason: Thief Gold reads mouse look through standard Windows input by default, which doesn't give high-resolution mice their full precision.
